scope: Narrow source/API review of the isolated ground-contact scorer and same-route two-half-segment simulation runner; not an episode result or physical-safety approval
reviewedProperties: Only original triangle IDs confirmed by the frozen seeded ground component are exempted; exact surface owner, mesh revision and model-to-reference transform are checked.
Height alone does not exempt triangles. Detached 1 cm tops, risers, walls and head-height triangles remain non-ground obstacles.
The prior continuous oriented actual-body and separate horizontal-margin enclosures are inherited without changing their dimensions or the explicit 2 mm ordinary-floor exclusion.

Ground counts include actual triangle intersections or contained vertices, not broadphase candidates. The loop completes after its first non-ground contact so ground/non-ground face-report counts are complete within the query cap.
The new runner retains the selected route and actor XZ/yaw. Connected-support height updates define two bounded physical half-segments; their combined 3D length is checked before motion is committed.
Missing or disconnected support terminates uncertainty. Non-ground contact terminates failure. Reference geometry does not select the route, correct horizontal pose or enter controller packets.
Arrival still requires actual goal proximity, delivered-pose stop, drained motion commands and nonzero actual distance. No standstill success is introduced.
limitations: Ground membership is an experimental simulation-world contact model, not semantic or measured ground truth.
Nine first-hit probes and midpoint/end support checks do not establish continuous support or absence of holes.
Conservative swept OBBs can overcount contact. Complete containment inside an unlabeled closed solid is not classified by surface intersections.
Ground triangle reports can repeat the same face across body/margin envelopes and half-segments; they are not unique physical events.
This review does not independently establish the candidate phone map's clearance, resolve admitted unknown flags, verify a successful journey or establish live iPhone safety.
